feature: Menu lab audit — the Code pill, composed two ways

callouts.text: 1 · Click this Code block. Its selection pill has exactly two dropdowns — Language and Font size — beside the Code-only rows. No Line thickness row: a Code block's frame is chrome, not an edge you paint.

2 · Open the ☰ main menu → Settings → Menu lab. Read the five preset card NAMES: Shape, Connector, Block title, Code block, Empty. Until this fix they painted near-white on near-white — only the grey descriptions were readable.
3 · Click the "Code block" preset. The composed menu should be the same two controls you just saw on the real pill — and the printed recipe should read items: ['codeLanguage', 'size'].
PASS WHEN · Every preset name is legible, and the lab's Code block preset composes Language + Font size — the same two controls the real Code block's pill shows, with no Line thickness row anywhere.
